_comment: Details of the seasonal deals announced on the homepage (#black-friday) and in the JustFlip app (Today card, paywall labels). THE SWITCH is not here: it is seasonal_offer in Firebase Remote Config (project justflip-prod, console > Remote Config, or ios/Tools/RemoteConfig/remote-config.py in the app repo): off | blackFriday | cyberMonday, naming an entry below by its theme. Website and app follow within minutes; no app release. The prices are set separately in App Store Connect (Lifetime price schedule; subscriptions as introductory offers, see ios/Tools/Offers/subscription-sale.py). The app labels a plan only while the store price backs it (Lifetime at most maxPriceVsYearly x Yearly; a subscription when the customer is offered a paid introductory price), but the website trusts the switch. plans: the discounted plans, the first is preselected on the paywall. id: a new id shows the Today card again to people who closed the previous one.
